title: SecurityLogSchema
description: Standardized schema for normalizing raw security logs into structured JSON format

timestamp.description: The exact time when the security event occurred in ISO 8601 format.

service.description: The internal system or service that generated the log (e.g., auth_service, web_server).

event_type.description: The classified, normalized category of the security event.

source_ip.description: The origin IPv4 address from which the request or attack originated.

user.description: The target username or system account being targeted or accessed.

raw_line.description: The original, unparsed raw log line preserved for forensic auditing.
